_doc_help: Strict-JSON example. The mod ignores any field starting with '_'. Use this variant if your editor refuses // comments.
_doc_enabled: Master switch. false = mod loaded but does nothing.
_doc_debugLog: Print every override decision to the Minecraft log. Lines start with '[TurnOverride]'.
_doc_mergeMode: REPLACE = only yours | PREPEND = yours + Mojang fallback | APPEND = Mojang first + yours fallback
_doc_forceRelay: true = no hole punching, always tunnel through TURN (RTCIceTransportPolicy.RELAY). Higher latency, but bypasses every NAT.
_doc_staticServers: One array entry == one set of credentials. The 'urls' inside one entry == same credentials, different transports/ports of the SAME server.

staticServers._doc: Entry A: home TURN, three transports, shared creds alice/s3cret
Entry B: cloud backup, different creds bob@cloud/hunter2

_doc_remote: Empty url = disabled. When enabled, fetched on EVERY TURN auth request. Auto-detects Mojang-native or browser-style RTCIceServer-array JSON.

remote._doc_headers: Arbitrary HTTP headers, e.g. Authorization: Bearer ...
remote._doc_timeoutMillis: Request timeout in ms. Falls back to Mojang on timeout.
